title: OCPE common definitions
description: Shared, reusable definitions referenced by every OCPE schema. This file is normative for OCPE specification 0.1.x. Identifier grammar is defined in specification/core/identifiers.md.

curie.description: Canonical OCPE identifier: ocpe:<namespace>/<local-id>. Namespace is the owning package id (dot-separated kebab-case segments); local-id is kebab-case.

symbol_ref.description: Reference to a model-local symbol: <model-curie>#<symbol>. Symbols are case-sensitive and scoped to the model that declares them.

entity_ref.description: Reference to an OCPE entity (CURIE) or to a model-local symbol (CURIE#symbol).

package_id.description: Package identifier. Equal to the namespace used in the CURIEs of entities the package defines.

reference_id.description: Identifier of a literature or data reference, expressed with a persistent-identifier scheme prefix (doi:, pmid:, pmcid:, isbn:, arxiv:, url:).

version_constraint.description: Version constraint: whitespace-separated comparators (>=, >, <=, <, =, ^, ~) combined with AND; alternatives separated by '||'. Example: '>=0.1.0 <0.2.0' or '^0.1.0'.

unit_code.description: Unit expressed as a UCUM case-sensitive code (e.g. 'mm[Hg]', 'mL/s', '/min', '1'). Semantic validity is checked against specification/core/units.yaml by the engine, not by this schema.

status.description: Lifecycle status of a specification artifact.

alias.description: Alternative name or symbol that resolves to the canonical identifier. Aliases are case-sensitive. A scope restricts where the alias is meaningful (e.g. a model CURIE for model symbols).

scope.description: Package id, model CURIE, or 'legacy-kb' for symbols from the pre-0.1 knowledge base.

unit.description: If the alias denotes the quantity expressed in a specific unit (e.g. 'Hc' = heart rate in beats/s).

external_mapping.description: Mapping to a term in an external terminology/ontology (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, UBERON, OBA). Mappings must not be invented; record only verified mappings.

context.description: Qualifies the circumstances under which a range, measurement characteristic, relationship or evidence claim applies. OCPE treats reference ranges and measurement performance as context-dependent, never as universal truths. Additional context dimensions may be added with string, number or boolean values.

population.description: Population entity reference or free-text description.

measurement_method.description: Measurement method entity reference or description.

scope_note.description: Plain-language statement of what the qualifying context is and is not.

reference_range.description: A context-qualified range of values. The range_type distinguishes population reference intervals from plausibility bounds, clinical thresholds and model validity domains, which must never be conflated.

model_representation.description: How a condition or intervention is represented inside a specific computational model. This is a model-specific representational hypothesis with its own evidence, not a claim about the condition itself.

unverified_parameter_perturbations.description: Perturbations whose magnitude is not verified. Consumers MUST treat these as inert unless explicitly opted in (legacy 'unverified_parameters' semantics).

factor.description: Multiplicative factor relative to baseline when the representation is expressed as a ratio.

curation_note.description: Verbatim curation/review note carried forward from legacy content.

validation_criterion.description: Acceptance criterion a model representation is expected to satisfy (e.g. a phenotype signature). Declaring a criterion does not assert that any model satisfies it.

entity_base.description: Properties shared by every OCPE entity. Kind-specific schemas compose this definition.

since.description: Package version in which this identifier was introduced.

curation_notes.description: Verbatim curation history and review annotations preserved from source content.
